Subject: one open navy toolbox containing five unmistakably different blank tactile tools: a small lesson ladder, two balance tokens, a faceted simulation piece, a reflection mirror, and interlocking team blocks; one orange handle unifies the set
Style/medium: premium tactile editorial illustration with crafted miniature objects and restrained dimensional depth
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; centered open toolbox as the dominant silhouette; organized fan of tools; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width
Lighting/mood: resourceful, optimistic, practical, calm studio backlighting
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Materials/textures: painted wood, folded paper, brushed metal without markings, soft felt lining
Constraints: all tools, blocks, and surfaces blank and unmarked; original composition; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, product UI, vendor logos, trademarks, watermarks, paws, paw imagery, paw logos, cats, cat silhouettes, or Microsoft Fluent styling
